title: Comment “Work” And I’ll send you the link 👇 ChatGPT just launched a new agent built for real work
description: Comment “Work” And I’ll send you the link 👇 ChatGPT just launched a new agent built for real work projects. It’s called ChatGPT Work, powered by GPT-5.6. Now when you open the desktop app you’ll see three options: Chat → asking questions Codex → developers Work → turning your goals into finished work Here’s what makes Work different: It gathers context from the apps and files you approve, builds a plan, and carries it through multiple steps to a polished output you can actually use. Documents, spreadsheets, presentations, even working web experiences. And it checks in with you on the big decisions along the way. For example, it can organize job listings, compare them to your experience, and build out your application materials and a tracker ready to review. This is a solid step forward for anyone using ChatGPT for bigger projects. ChatGPT Work is available today in ChatGPT on web and mobile for Pro, Enterprise, and Edu, with Plus and Business rolling out over the next few days. In the ChatGPT desktop app, Chat, Work, and Codex are available on every plan, including Free, and is available globally to download on Windows and Mac. Download or update the ChatGPT desktop app to try it. #ChatGPT #AI #OpenAI #ChatGPTWork #ChatGPT_Partner ChatGPT
transcript: Breaking news, Chat GPT just got a massive update that could change the way that you take on larger work projects. So, OpenAI just launched Chat GPT Work, a new agent in Chat GPT powered by GPT 5.6 designed for larger work projects that require context, planning, and multiple steps. So, inside the Chat GPT desktop app, you're now going to see three different options: chat, work, and codex. Chat is for asking questions, codex is for developers, and work is the new agent designed to take your goals and turn them into finished work. So, here's what's newly possible. Work can gather context from the apps and files you approve, propose a plan, and help carry it through multiple steps towards a polished output you can review, refine, and use. Like a document, a spreadsheet, a presentation, or even a working web experience. While making sure to check in with you on the important decisions along the way. For example, it can organize a set of job listings, compare them with the experience you provide, and create application materials and a tracker ready for you to review. So, this is a big step for Chat GPT because it builds on the Chat GPT experience you already know by helping with a much larger part of the project. Like gathering context and planning the work to create polished outputs. It expands what's possible so you can take on your most ambitious ideas that once felt out of reach. So, just download or update the Chat GPT desktop app and try Chat GPT Work today.
